caseName: St. Louis Board of Education v. Caldwell
caseNameFull: St. Louis Board of Education v. Caldwell

opinions.text:
Application to recall and stay mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, presented to Mr. Justice Blackmun, and by him referred to the Court, denied by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
